Sam (AE): FYI GreenWave Therapeutics wants a 45-day on-prem POC (air-gapped). Theyre asking us to waive the one-time onboarding fee and include Silver support during the eval. Can we structure this?
Nora (Sales Ops): what's GreenWave's stated outcome? any $ signal or timeline to convert?
Sam (AE): they said if model performance matches internal benchmarks well be fast-tracked to a 12mo reserved deal. CTO wants to avoid upfront platform fees during the biotech pilot.
Frida (Deal Desk): full waive + Silver is high cost. We could do a conditional credit: waive onboarding now, but it becomes invoiced unless they sign a minimum 6mo paid pilot or a 12mo reserved contract within X days. Need details on acceptable X and credit mechanics.
Mina (SE): technical scope: air-gapped packaging, KMS integration (BYOK), and HA config for the pilot. Estimate 16 SE hours for setup + 4 hours of dry-run.
Jordan (CS): Silver support would include 24/7 for P0 outages; that's heavy. Could include Bronze + 8 hours of Silver on-call cover for the POC if we defer the fee.
BillingBot: standard SKUs -> ONPREM-ONBOARD: $20,000 one-time; PLATFORM-MO: $4,000/mo; SUPPORT-BRONZE: $2,500/mo; SUPPORT-SILVER: $8,000/mo.
Frida (Deal Desk): proposal: immediate waiver of onboarding fee, but customer signs an MOU that (a) defines success criteria and (b) commits to either a paid 6mo pilot at 50% list or a 12mo reserved contract within 75 days after POC end. If they convert, onboarding is permanently waived and credited. If they do not convert, onboarding fee invoiced and due. We include Bronze support + 8hrs SE; one weekend dry-run included.
Kai (Finance): deferral/waiver acceptable if memo describes invoicing trigger and we have a receivable to capture if not converted. 75 day conversion window ok. Need GL code for credited onboarding when converted.
LegalBot: air-gapped requires on-prem addendum and additional indemnity language. MOU should reference addendum. Turnaround ~7 business days.
Sam (AE): restating for the customer: waive onboarding up-front provided GreenWave signs MOU with success criteria, names POC lead, agrees to conversion mechanics (6mo paid pilot @50% list or 12mo reserved within 75 days). Bronze support + 8 SE hrs included; Silver on-call can be purchased separately.
Frida (Deal Desk): I'll write a succinct deal memo with these bullets and route for approval. Approval path: Frida -> Nora -> Kai.
Nora (Sales Ops): please include the exact SKU lines and the language: "Onboarding fee will be invoiced if no conversion within 75 days of POC completion."
Jordan (CS): I'll prepare the POC runbook (SSO/SAML checklist, BYOK steps, rollback plan) and send to Sam.
Mina (SE): scheduling note: need a 2hr architecture call before dry-run.
Kai (Finance): once memo posted, I'll confirm revenue treatment and billing trigger.
Frida (Deal Desk): memo ETA 3pm PT. Will post link here.
Sam (AE): can I get a short pasteable quote for the customer now?
Mina (SE): paste-in quote snippet:```
SKUs:
- ONPREM-ONBOARD x1 (waived/conditional) — list $20,000 — waived up-front; invoiced if no conversion within 75 days after POC
- PLATFORM-MO (POC rate) x2 months — list $4,000/mo — customer billed at 50% if they choose 6mo paid pilot; otherwise billed per agreed terms after conversion
- SUPPORT-BRONZE x2 months — list $2,500/mo — included during POC
- SE-ONBOARD-HOURS 16hrs — included; additional hours billed at standard rate
Notes: 45-day POC, MOU with success criteria required, on-prem addendum required for air-gapped. Onboarding fee credited to first invoice upon conversion.
```
Nora (Sales Ops): good. Add line that Silver support can be added at prorated rate if requested.
Frida (Deal Desk): memo posted -> internal link: https://redwood.company/dealdesk/memos/2098765432
Kai (Finance): reviewed. :white_check_mark:
LegalBot: will circulate addendum template to Sam.
Sam (AE): thanks team. I'll send the MOU + quote and try to lock dates. Will update thread with customer response.
